result:
Now I have everything verified. Here are the complete answers:

---

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:153`, called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`. The runner is created at line 162, run once immediately at line 163, then launched in a goroutine ticker loop at lines 166–171.

**h02.** Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (called via `PostAsync` which enqueues onto a buffered channel drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()`). Protection mechanism — two layers: (1) registration-time `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` DNS-resolves the host and rejects reserved/private CIDRs; (2) delivery-time `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` re-resolves at connect time to defeat DNS rebinding. Both use `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`).

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` in `internal/idp/idp.go`). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol, in `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`). This is the only concrete protocol that ships.

**h04.** No. `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once in the codebase at `store/db/db.go:22`, inside the `NewDBDriver` factory's `switch` branch. No direct construction exists anywhere else (including tests, which use `db.NewDBDriver` or construct `sqlite.NewDB` directly, never `mysql.NewDB`).

**h05.** Explicit Go code. The `deleteUserTargetsTx` function in each DB driver explicitly deletes reactions in two passes: (1) `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` removes reactions on the user's memos (e.g., `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96`), and (2) `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` removes reactions the user created on any content (e.g., `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:102`). The same pattern exists in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go` and `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go`. The `reaction` table schema in all three backends (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql`) has no FOREIGN KEY or ON DELETE CASCADE.

**h06.** Handlers (≥3): `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (same file:401), `DeleteMemo` (same file:518), `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`). Convergence function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07.**
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:167`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` (e.g. SQLite `DB.ListUsers`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`
- Back in `serveUserAvatar`: `parseDataURI` decodes the base64 data URI from the `avatar_url` column — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:196`

**h08.**
- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — invoked? yes — callers: `server/server.go:163` and self-call in `Runner.Run` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — invoked? no — no production caller (only `RebuildMemoPayload` is called from `memo_service.go`, not `RunOnce`)

**h09.** Count: **6** distinct `Close` declarations. Invoked declarers with callers:
- `SSEHub.Close` — called by `server/server.go:206`
- `Store.Close` — called by `server/server.go:146`
- `Cache.Close` — called by `Store.Close` at `store/store.go:74-76` (3 instances)
- `DB.Close` (sqlite/postgres/mysql) — called by `Store.Close` via `s.driver.Close()` at `store/store.go:78` (one active at runtime depending on driver)

**h10.** `CompileToStatement` on `Engine` — `internal/filter/engine.go` — approx 22 call sites (grep) / ~34 inbound edges in the graph. It is the filter engine's main entry point called throughout the store layer.

**h11.** 1st: `User` (~6 packages outside `store/`); 2nd: `Memo` (~4 packages outside `store/`).

**h12.** Concrete method: `(*DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (executes `INSERT INTO memo ... RETURNING id, created_ts, updated_ts, row_status`). Determination: the default driver is `"sqlite"` set by `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `cmd/memos/main.go:122`; the `NewDBDriver` switch at `store/db/db.go:18` selects `sqlite.NewDB` for that value, so the SQLite path runs by default.

**h13.** Implementation: unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:59` (wraps goldmark). Construction: `markdown.NewService()` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`. Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14.** Computation site: `ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`, orchestrated by `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (same file:447), and bulk `RunOnce` rebuild (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`). Extracted properties: `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` (first H1 heading text). Also extracts tags and mentions.

**h15.**
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo, ListMemoComments parent check) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query-level visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-222`
- `ListMemoComments` query-level filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:157-161`
- `CreateMemoComment` private-memo gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- RSS feeds (explore + per-user) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `server/router/rss/rss.go:141`
- Reaction service (list + upsert) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30` and `:83`
- Memo attachment listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214`
- File server attachment download — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`
- SSE event filtering (`canReceive`) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- Email notifications (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — `server/notification/email.go:306`
- API notifications (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302`
- Sitemap — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- User stats — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84`

**r01.** Premise correction: there is no Redis. The cache layer is a pure in-memory `sync.Map`-based cache implemented in `store/cache/cache.go`. User entries use the default TTL of 10 minutes, configured in `store/store.go:40-45`.

**r02.** Premise correction: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The codebase has no rate limiter. Access control is handled by the `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` (authentication + method-level authorization only).

**r03.** Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The only scheduled background runner is the S3 presign URL refresher (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) running every 12 hours. No database cleanup task is registered.

**r04.** Premise correction: neither NATS nor RabbitMQ. Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()`. There is no external message broker.

**r05.** Premise correction: there is no GraphQL API. The public API is gRPC + gRPC-Gateway (REST) + Connect, defined via Protocol Buffer `.proto` files in `proto/api/v1/` (e.g., `memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`).
